sections.heading: B — Audience and scope
sections.markdown:
## B — Audience and scope

Audience: first-time Connecticut applicants preparing in English for the Class D knowledge test; this section matters to every driver facing breakdowns, equipment failure, skids and crash scenes.
Level: plain-English reading level; no prior driving vocabulary is assumed, so each manual term is defined where it first appears.
Prerequisites: the control, maneuver and road-rule chapters before it; this section continues chapter four.
Section scope: manual chapter four, emergencies part: signaling, breakdowns, equipment failure, collision avoidance, skids, crashes and crash reporting.
Out of scope: markings, signals and signs detail, licensing paperwork, and anything not printed on the selected manual pages.
